preamble: Write ONE self-contained HTML file (inline CSS and JS, no external assets, no build step). For 3D use only core three.js via: import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js' inside <script type="module"> (no addons, no OrbitControls). Fullscreen canvas, starts animating immediately, no user input needed, no console errors. HARD LIMIT: your whole reply must be under 12000 tokens. Reply with the raw HTML only, no explanation, no markdown fences.

tasks.walker: TASK: a 3D articulated fighter (head, torso, pelvis, upper/lower arms with hands, upper/lower legs with feet; joint hierarchy built from primitives, every joint animated) performing a looping ~15 s parkour-combat gauntlet in a walled arena: sprint start, wall-RUN along a tall striped wall (body tilted, feet on the wall, 4+ steps), wall-JUMP push off into a backflip, roll landing into a crouch, then a 5-hit combo (jab, cross, roundhouse kick, spinning slash with a visible weapon arc trail, ground slam with shockwave ring), an enemy dummy that staggers/knocked back per hit and collapses at the end, then reset and loop. Camera: smooth follow with lag + a hard cut to slow-motion close-up on the slam. Checkered floor with scuff decals, directional light with soft shadows, coloured rim/point lights, dust particles on landings, fog, crowd-free stands background. On-screen phase name + hit counter.
tasks.physics: TASK: a 3D EXTREME Rube-Goldberg chain reaction, loop ~15 s, NO physics library (hand-written rigid motion and collisions only): 20+ dominoes in an S-curve with a BRANCH (two arms topple and re-merge at a bridge piece), last domino hits a marble that spirals down a funnel tower, drops onto one end of a seesaw launching a second ball, which swings a pendulum hammer that smashes a block stack, falling blocks tip a pulley bucket that hoists a flag AND lights a lamp at the timed finale (flag+light within the last second). Every stage must visibly cause the next; a camera that tracks the action; numbered stage labels (1-7) that light up as each stage fires; dust puffs on impacts; auto-reset when done.
tasks.gears: TASK: a working clockwork ORRERY-automaton in which ALL motion derives from one master angle: a gear train of 12+ gears with correct tooth counts, meshing and opposite rotation (show at least 3 different gear sizes), an anchor escapement driven by a swinging pendulum that visibly ticks once per second, a dial with hour/minute/second hands at correct ratios, a cam-and-follower lifting a hammer that strikes a bell on every 5th tick (bell visibly shakes + ring flash), PLUS a small orrery arm above the dial with 2 planets orbiting at a 1:4 ratio, AND a walking mini-figure whose legs are driven by a second cam via linkages. Layered 3D layout (front dial plate, mid gear bed, back pillars), metallic PBR-ish materials, fake environment lighting, dust motes, subtle camera drift + slow push-in.
tasks.shader: TASK: a full-screen WebGL fragment shader (raw WebGL or a three.js full-screen quad) raymarching a RICH animated SDF scene: 6+ different primitives (sphere, torus, box, capsule, cylinder, octahedron) with animated smooth-min morphing/blending over a reflective checkered floor, soft shadows, ambient occlusion, ONE-bounce reflections, fresnel/rim glow, emissive lava cracks pulsing on one shape, floating particles (starfield or sparks), vignette + filmic tone mapping + gamma, fog by distance, and an animated camera flying a smooth spline (orbit + dive + rise) with look-at target. Must compile on first try; keep the march loop under 128 steps.
